stories.title: Jazz silence Lakers, win back-to-back games for first time this season
stories.summary: The Utah Jazz followed their streak-snapping victory over the Clippers yesterday with a gritty back-to-back win over the Lakers on Wednesday night.

stories.title: Lagoon's new roller coaster honors retired ride while shooting for the stars
stories.summary: New details on Lagoon's new roller coaster were released on Tuesday at an expo in Orlando, Florida.

stories.title: International competition to help Salt Lake City as it eyes $58M Civic Center overhaul
stories.summary: Salt Lake City wants to overhaul the land outside of City Hall and its main library, and it's now getting the help of a major international design competition for one of its elements.

stories.title: Muslims are projected to outnumber Christians by 2035 as the world's largest religion
stories.summary: Islam is expected to surpass Christianity as the world's largest religion by 2035, according to detailed projections released Wednesday by the Pew Research Center.

stories.title: Logan man nearing end of Utah golf bucket list he started with his father
stories.summary: A Utah man has been golfing with his father since he was seven years old. Together, they came up with a unique bucket list idea. But that goal has taken on a whole new meaning.

stories.title: Man dies after rollover crash in Millard County
stories.summary: A 32-year-old man was killed in a rollover crash after he lost control of his vehicle due to black ice early Wednesday, according to police.

stories.title: Tooele County Council member, assistant fire chief charged with sex abuse
stories.summary: Tooele County Councilman Erik Stromberg is facing felony sex abuse charges based on incidents alleged to have occurred in 2023.

stories.title: $500 car deposit receipt leaves refund terms unclear at Utah dealership
stories.summary: A Bountiful man says an Orem car dealership promised to refund his $500 deposit. The dealership says the refund came with a condition.

stories.title: New 'Toxic Hall of Shame' includes Publix, Trader Joe's and McDonald's
stories.summary: Released just in time for the holidays, the 2026 Toxic Hall of Shame gives 16 major retailers an F for their failure to prioritize reducing hazardous chemicals and plastics in their products.

stories.title: Park City Council votes to table long-discussed housing project
stories.summary: The Park City Council recently voted 3-2 to shelve the decades-long Bonanza Park project, which would have brought dozens of affordable housing units to the area.

stories.title: Kaysville officials begin search for interim mayor
stories.summary: Kaysville officials have started their search for a new mayor as Mayor Tami Tran prepares to take her new seat in the Utah Senate.

stories.title: Grand Canyon's South Rim hotels to reopen as park eases water restrictions
stories.summary: Officials at Grand Canyon National Park announced that they are easing water restrictions, meaning hotels on the South Rim will be able to accommodate overnight guests.
